question: The Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India comes under the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India comes under the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• This office is responsible for conducting the decennial Census of India and providing vital statistics on population, birth, and death rates.
 
• The Census data is crucial for planning and policy-making at various levels of government.
 
• It plays a significant role in the allocation of resources and the implementation of welfare programs across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Home Affairs** is a key ministry in the Government of India, responsible for internal security, border management, and administration of Union Territories.
 
• It also oversees disaster management, the Central Armed Police Forces, and the implementation of the official languages policy.
 
• The Registrar General and Census Commissioner office was established in 1949, and it has been conducting the Census since then.
 
• The Census is conducted every ten years, with the last Census being held in 2011 and the next scheduled for 2021.
